Vendored from Citadel 0.12.1, revision ae8562f895de06ccb86fdb1cbb65fd99c8976e12 (MIT).

OpenSSHKey.swift accepts bcrypt rounds 1...256 instead of <32. This is a work bound, not an encryption strength limit. Package.swift omits unused example/test targets and ColorizeSwift.

The same parser now accepts full-block OpenSSH padding and validates every padding byte (upstream rejected full blocks and skipped the last byte).

bcrypt-kdf.c uses BCRYPT_KDF_WORDS for its eight-word KDF state, avoiding a collision with bcrypt.h's six-word BCRYPT_WORDS. The values and algorithm are unchanged.

ExecHandler.swift uses NIOPipeBootstrap.takingOwnershipOfDescriptors(input:output:) instead of its deprecated withPipes(inputDescriptor:outputDescriptor:) alias. Descriptor ownership is unchanged.
